services.name: Fall Fishing
services.desc: Looking for a fun and memorable outdoor activity the whole family can enjoy? A fishing charter in Virginia Beach and the Chesapeake Bay area offers the perfect way to connect with nature, learn a new skill, and create lasting memories - all while exploring the beautiful waters that this region is known for. At Captain Hogg’s Charters, we specialize in family-friendly fishing adventures aboard our spacious and comfortable boat, the Smokin’ Gun II. Fishing is an incredible activity for all ages. variants.label: Evening fishing charter in Chesapeake Bay

blurb: Guests fish year-round aboard the "Smokin' Gun II", a 40' custom-built Evans boat designed for comfort, speed, and safety. Charters are led by Captain Chandler Hogg and include half-day, full-day, or evening trips targeting species like cobia, red drum, black drum, striped bass, flounder, and trout. The boat is Coast Guard-certified for up to 32 passengers and equipped with top-tier fishing gear and electronics.

quotes.author: A Murd
quotes.text: A Murd4 years agoHad a great time on a half day charter! Captain and first mate were very welcoming and knowledgeable. We ended up catching bluefish, spade and Spanish mackerel. The first mate was amazing at his job and did his best to keep my 5 yr old involved (it was very hot that day and my kiddo was over everything about an hour in). The first mate even set up a rod for my son so he could catch other species in order to get his junior angler award (which he got!)! Would definitely recommend a trip with Captain Hogg's if you're in the area!!

quotes.author: karen griffith
quotes.text: karen griffith3 years agoMy family and myself had a blast on this trip. Captain Chandler took us straight to the bay and knew exactly where the fish were. My boys were so excited to catch monster fish and the mate JJ was amazing helping them. He knew exactly what to do and how to reel the fish in. We will definitely be back next year for another trip with them!

quotes.author: Matt Seawell
quotes.text: Matt Seawell2 years agoCaptain Hogg treated us to a very great outing. He and his first mate led us to catch more fish than anticipated. He was very flexible with our timing fluctuations. His boat provided plenty of indoor seating and plenty of shade. I would highly recommend him to friends and family.

This was ABSOLUTELY the best one-day family event we have ever had. I’ve been on fishing charters before and knew what to expect; however, the crew on the Smoking Gun II was exceptional!! It all started with a phone call to Captain Hogg, and everything was perfect from there.”— Mark C

We had a fantastic time. Captain Chandler Hogg got us to the fish quick. Then First Mate, Brett kept up with our bait and catches. We limited out in both Spade and Mackerel. We will definitely be back!”— Teri B

We had a great time fishing with Captain Hogg last summer. After a good haul of spadefish, we also landed a cobia. The boat is comfortable, and the crew worked hard to show our charter a good time.”— Hunter W
